in_marathi.name: Devidas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devidas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Devidas' is derived from 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'idas' meaning 'gift'. This name is given to a child believed to be a gift from the gods.
